purpose: Small explicit pin set for project-owner-mandated cross-branch receipts that must survive bounded active-context selection. Pins consume the normal packet budget and do not alter evidence rank or promotion status.
rules: A mandatory pin guarantees retrieval presence only; it does not promote the pinned claim.
Pinned material keeps its original provenance/evidence status.
Pinned files count against the normal active packet budget.
Keep this set small; normal relevance selection remains the default for ordinary knowledge.
